nodes.summary: A Riesz basis has dense span.
nodes.title: Riesz bases have dense span

nodes.summary: A Riesz basis admits a biorthogonal dual family with a reconstruction formula: there is `g : ι → E` with `⟪f i, g j⟫ = if i = j then 1 else 0` and `x = ∑' i, ⟪g i, x⟫ • f i` for every `x`. The dual is `g j = (T⁻¹)† (b j)` for the operator `T` witnessing that `f` is a Riesz basis.
nodes.title: Biorthogonal dual of a Riesz basis

nodes.summary: If `b` is a Hilbert basis and `∑' i, ‖f i - b i‖ ^ 2 < 1`, then `f` is a Riesz basis.
nodes.title: Paley–Wiener stability theorem

nodes.summary: A family `f : ι → E` is a Riesz basis (with respect to the Hilbert basis `b`) if it is the image of `b` under a bounded invertible operator.
nodes.title: Riesz basis of a Hilbert space

nodes.summary: A Riesz basis is linearly independent.
nodes.title: Riesz bases are linearly independent

nodes.summary: The `ℓ²` norm of the norms of a coefficient sequence is the norm of the sequence.
nodes.title: $\ell^2$ norm of the norm sequence

nodes.summary: The sequence of norms of an `ℓ²` coefficient sequence, as an element of `ℓ²(ι, ℝ)`.
nodes.title: Norm sequence of an $\ell^2$ coefficient sequence

nodes.summary: The sequence of norms of a square-summable family, as an element of `ℓ²(ι, ℝ)`.
nodes.title: Norm sequence of a square-summable family

nodes.summary: The operator norm of the synthesis operator is at most `√(∑' i, ‖d i‖ ^ 2)`.
nodes.title: Operator norm bound for the synthesis operator

nodes.summary: Norm bound for a synthesis series, by Cauchy–Schwarz for `ℓ²`.
nodes.title: Norm bound for a synthesis series

nodes.summary: The norms of the terms of a synthesis series are summable when the coefficient sequence is in `ℓ²` and the synthesized family is square-summable: this is Cauchy–Schwarz for `ℓ²`, via `lp.tsum_mul_le_mul_norm` applied to the two real `ℓ²` sequences of norms.
nodes.title: Absolute summability of a synthesis series

nodes.summary: The terms of a synthesis series are summable when the coefficient sequence is in `ℓ²` and the synthesized family is square-summable.
nodes.title: Summability of a synthesis series

nodes.summary: The synthesis operator at a basis vector picks out one term of the family.
nodes.title: Synthesis operator on a basis vector

nodes.summary: The synthesis operator: for a square-summable family `d : ι → E`, the bounded operator `ℓ²(ι, 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E` sending `c` to `∑' i, c i • d i`.
nodes.title: Synthesis operator of a square-summable family

nodes.summary: The linear map underlying the synthesis operator.
nodes.title: Linear map underlying the synthesis operator

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
